commands.name: offer.tracking.get

commands.name: offer.tracking.update
commands.summary: Update offer tracking event mapping, consent requirement and assets
commands.description: Uses the authenticated owner and immutable offerId. Does not accept tokens, grant visitor consent, spend on ads, or claim Meta attribution equals first-party revenue. Read current config first. Omitted events.custom preserves saved definitions; a supplied array replaces all definitions, and [] removes them. Use returned customEventTargets; no raw JS, financial payload or reserved standard event names.

commands.name: offer.tracking.getLedger
commands.summary: Read the owner's first-party conversion ledger by currency
commands.description: Uses the authenticated owner and immutable offerId. Does not accept tokens, grant visitor consent, spend on ads, or claim Meta attribution equals first-party revenue. Totals cover recorded matching conversions only; historical coverage remains partial with unknown instrumentation start and no performed backfill. Never infer complete historical revenue from the first recorded row.

commands.name: offer.tracking.getDeliveryDiagnostics
commands.summary: Read owner-scoped conversion delivery status without visitor PII
commands.description: Uses the authenticated owner and immutable offerId. Does not accept tokens, grant visitor consent, spend on ads, or claim Meta attribution equals first-party revenue.

commands.name: offer.tracking.events.list
commands.summary: Query the owner's central event journal across all or selected offers with cursor pagination
commands.description: Uses the authenticated owner and immutable offerId. Does not accept tokens, grant visitor consent, spend on ads, or claim Meta attribution equals first-party revenue. Omit offerIds for all owned offers; supplied IDs select only that owned subset. Browser observation/Pixel attempts, Meta acceptance and business verification are distinct. Correlated browser/server rows are not additional purchases or revenue.

commands.summary: Update a digital product's fields.
commands.description: Patches an existing product (title, description, price, currency, type, status). bundleChildIds replaces an owned BUNDLE's child selection; children must be owned non-bundle products. Does not touch deliverables — use offer.product.addDeliverable / removeDeliverable for those.

bundleChildIds.description: Replace bundle child products with this ordered nonempty owned-product selection

examples: rename product prod_1 to Pro Pack

commands.name: offer.product.remove
commands.summary: Delete a digital product.
commands.description: Soft-deletes a product the caller owns (status='deleted'). The product is removed from the library and drops out of any offer's attached list. Existing links are left in place but ignored. Proceed only when the user explicitly asks to delete.

commands.name: offer.product.restore
commands.summary: Restore a deleted digital product.
commands.description: Reactivates a product that was soft-deleted with offer.product.remove (status back to 'active'), returning it to the library.

commands.name: offer.product.addDeliverable
commands.summary: Attach a deliverable file or link to a product.
commands.description: Adds one deliverable the buyer/lead receives. kind=file needs a private blobPath from POST /api/digital-products/upload (Desktop /api/bridge/offer-studio/product-upload), never public offer.media.upload images; kind=url needs an http(s) url. This wires the actual downloadable/redirect asset onto a digital product.

blobPath.description: For kind=file: private blob path from POST /api/digital-products/upload (Desktop product-upload adapter)

examples: add this pdf as a deliverable to prod_1
add a Notion template link to my product

commands.name: offer.product.removeDeliverable
commands.summary: Remove a deliverable from a product.
commands.description: Removes the deliverable with the given id from a product.

commands.name: offer.product.attachToOffer
commands.summary: Attach a digital product to the offer.
commands.description: Links a product the caller owns to the current offer so its deliverables are sold (paid mode) or given away (free mode). Idempotent per (offer, product).

offerName.description: Offer slug. Defaults to the current Offer Studio context.

examples: attach product prod_1 to this offer
add my ebook to this offer as a bonus

commands.name: offer.product.detachFromOffer
commands.summary: Detach a digital product from the offer.
commands.description: Removes the link between a product and the current offer. The product itself is not deleted.

offerName.description: Offer slug. Defaults to the current Offer Studio context.

examples: remove product prod_1 from this offer

commands.name: offer.product.listForOffer
commands.summary: List digital products attached to the offer.
commands.description: Returns the products currently linked to the offer, in display order.

offerName.description: Offer slug. Defaults to the current Offer Studio context.

examples: what products are on this offer

commands.name: offer.digital.preflight
commands.summary: Check whether the digital offer is ready to launch.
commands.description: Audits the offer's digital setup and reports blocking issues before launch: whether products are attached, each attached product actually has a deliverable, paid/free mode matches pricing (paid needs a price on products or a checkout base price; free needs a free product), the lead-capture form includes an email field (free mode), and capture copy is present. Returns ready=true only when there are no error-level issues.

offerName.description: Offer slug. Defaults to the current Offer Studio context.

examples: is this digital offer ready to launch

commands.name: offer.media.generateImage
commands.summary: AI-generate an image and add it to the media library.
commands.description: Text-to-image generation. Produces an image from the prompt, uploads it to the creator's media library, and returns the hosted URL so the AI can reference it in a section (e.g. a hero background or feature illustration). Optionally set it as the offer's social/OG image.

prompt.description: What to generate, e.g. 'a minimal 3D illustration of a rocket on a dark gradient'

setAsOgImage.description: Also set this image as the offer's meta.ogImage

offerName.description: Offer slug. Defaults to the current Offer Studio context.

examples: generate a hero image of a glowing dashboard
make an OG image for this launch and set it
